units: Blender metres, Z up, character faces -Y in rest pose (Blender front view), 30 fps clips

bolts.name: Walt "Bolts" Mercer
bolts.role: host; never speaks (third-person narrator), reacts with body language

proportions.build: stocky: broad shoulders, thick neck, slight belly (belly sits ~3 cm forward of chest line in profile), strong forearms (+15 % vs average), big hands
proportions.style: simple-realistic (modern animated-explainer quality): realistic proportions, slightly simplified surface detail, NOT cartoon/chibi

locked_body.status: LOCKED series default (approved by Irfan 25 Nov 2026, session 11)
locked_body.base: Quaternius Universal Base Characters Superhero_Male_FullBody (CC0) + UAL1 animations; BOLTS_IMPL=s9 (characters.py), MH_BOLTS_PROP=s11 (characters_s9.py)
locked_body.proportions: s11 normalized: regular ~40-year-old hands-on man with a modest belly
locked_body.rule: Do NOT change body, proportions or BOLTS_IMPL/MH_BOLTS_PROP mid-series. Every episode renders with s9 + s11; never mix with s6 or the s9 profile. Any change needs Irfan's approval and a full re-render of every unposted episode.
locked_body.note: The descriptive fields above (weight, chest/waist inches, 'broad shoulders', 'big hands') are the original concept brief; where they differ, the locked s11 measurements win.

eyes.shape: friendly, crow's-feet wrinkles at the corners

beard.style: short salt-and-pepper, ~1 cm, full jaw + moustache

hair.style: short, a bit messy at the back; mostly under headgear
hair.mesh: low shell + ~120 hair cards; hidden-under-cap variant (scalp shell only)

signatures._rule: all four stay visible in EVERY outfit and every camera angle that frames his head/torso; recognisable at 1 inch thumbnail

safety_glasses.desc: round safety glasses pushed UP onto the forehead (never over the eyes)
safety_glasses.placement: rests on the forehead just above the eyebrows; with any headgear it sits BELOW the brim/cuff, on the skin

red_bandana.desc: bandana tied around the neck, knot at the front-left, small triangle hanging
red_bandana.pattern: faint off-white paisley #F4EDE4 at 15 % (solid red read from distance)
red_bandana.cloth: baked shape + 2 jiggle bones (no cloth sim)

carpenters_pencil.desc: flat carpenter's pencil behind the RIGHT ear

tape_measure.desc: yellow tape measure (feet/inches) clipped on the belt at the LEFT front hip
tape_measure.note: with coveralls/overalls it clips on the coverall belt or chest pocket edge at the same left-front spot

budgets.textures: core = ONE 2K set (base color, normal, ORM packed) atlas for body/head/signatures; each outfit = its own 1K set; HDRI/scene budget per BUILD-SPEC
budgets.outfit_swap: outfit meshes are separate objects parented to the same armature, switched with keyframed hide_render/hide_viewport (switch only inside a whip)

rig.face: jaw, brows (2), eyelids (4), eye aim, cheek squash — no lip-sync needed

walk.desc: steady stocky walk, slight sway, arms relaxed

wrench.desc: two-hand ratchet/wrench turns at chest height

point.desc: points at the build with the right arm, looks back at camera

inspect.desc: leans in, squints, tilts head (often pulls glasses down for a second then pushes them back up)

thumbs_up.desc: IT WORKS beat: grin + right thumbs-up toward camera

hands_on_hips.desc: reveal pose: hands on hips, chest out, nods

scratch_beard.desc: SNAG beat: scratches beard with the left hand, looks at the problem

winch_crank.desc: cranks a hand winch (Build #1 tower raise; reusable)

outfits._keys: meshes = separate outfit objects; hidden = core-body parts hidden under the outfit; colors = hex; props = hand/belt props; signatures_visible must include all four

workshop.use: default — general builds, reveals, episode intros
workshop.signature_notes: glasses on forehead below the cap brim

props: red pen in coat breast pocket
scientist.signature_notes: tape measure on the pants belt, visible through the open coat

electrician.signature_notes: glasses on forehead below the hard-hat brim; tape measure clipped to the coverall belt left front

welder.headgear: auto-darkening helmet flipped UP on its headband
welder.signature_notes: glasses still on forehead under the flipped helmet; tape measure peeks out at the apron's left edge

plumber.signature_notes: glasses on forehead fully visible (no brim); tape measure clipped on the overall side-button area left

farmer.signature_notes: glasses on forehead under the hat brim — tilt the hat slightly back so they read

props: red shop rag in back pocket
mechanic.signature_notes: two reds (bandana + rag) — keep the rag small and at the back

digger.signature_notes: earmuffs sit around the BACK of the neck with cups at the sides — bandana knot stays visible at the front; tape measure on the jeans belt

roofer.headgear: white hard hat with chin strap
roofer.signature_notes: harness chest strap sits below the bandana; chin strap runs behind the beard

winter.headgear: red beanie, cuff rolled ABOVE the ears
winter.signature_notes: glasses rest on the forehead just under the beanie cuff; pencil behind the right ear stays visible; bandana shows at the open collar; tape measure clipped on the jacket's left pocket edge

travel.use: trip locations (away episodes) — added per Irfan's multi-location spec
travel.signature_notes: jacket open so the bandana and the belt tape measure stay visible; glasses on forehead below the brim

torque_goose.name: Torque
torque_goose.species_look: white domestic farm goose (Embden-type), plump, upright, alert
torque_goose.style: same simple-realistic style as Bolts; expressive head/neck, no clothing or accessories

budgets.texture: one 1K set (base color, normal, ORM); feathers = normal map + a few wing-tip cards

rig.bones: ~30: spine 3, neck 5, head, jaw (bill open), wings 3x2, legs 4x2, tail

peck.desc: dips and pecks at the ground / steals a washer

honk.desc: neck stretched forward, bill open twice (SFX honk)

sit.desc: settles down, tucks feet; holds as a loop end pose (Build #9 warm bench)

chase.desc: fast run, neck low, wings half open (chases the peeking neighbor)

red_pickup.desc: old full-size regular-cab pickup, 1990s boxy styling, 8 ft bed — GENERIC: no badge, no grille logo, no tailgate lettering, no license-plate text

budgets.texture: 1K (2K only if a reel features it close-up)
